title: 拆开小信封  (Opening the Small Envelope)

segments.t: Teacher Song sits beside Qing and Hao on the sunlit garden bench as Qing gently lifts the thirty-year-old red wax seal on the small square envelope. Listen first.
小晴，轻轻掀开信封口吧；这个小信封从五月起就耐心等着了。
里面是一张折好的米白卡片，用的还是那种干净利落的制图员墨水！
小晴，请把每个字都大声念给我们听吧。
亲爱的梧桐巷朋友们，如果你们今天坐在我们最喜欢的公园长椅上……
那么九号房的绿色百叶窗又向街坊敞开啦！
再听下一行：三十个夏天以前，五个朋友定下了一个星期六的约定。
小晴，当年我的教授和小院的朋友们定了什么约定呀？
在红星阳台挂上灯笼，再一起分享莓果杏仁蛋糕！
哇，真美好——卡片最底下还有一行备注小字吗？
快看：这个星期留意前台的信箱，因为我说话算话！
等等——两个星期前他已经从国外寄来第一张明信片了！
会不会我们出门走路的时候，第二封消息已经到小院客栈了？！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
小晴，轻轻掀开信封口吧；这个小信封从五月起就耐心等着了。
'Open the flap gently, Qing; that little envelope has waited patiently since May.' "Cong wuyue qi" frames "from May onward", while "xiankai" pictures gently lifting up a paper flap or lid.
里面是一张折好的米白卡片，用的还是那种干净利落的制图员墨水！
'Inside is a folded ivory note card written in the same crisp mapmaker ink!' "Mibai" literally says "rice-white" for warm ivory paper, and "liluo" praises neat, crisp penmanship.
小晴，请把每个字都大声念给我们听吧。
'Please read every word aloud for us, Qing.' "Nian gei women ting" chains "read aloud" with "for us to listen", naming both the action and the audience.
亲爱的梧桐巷朋友们，如果你们今天坐在我们最喜欢的公园长椅上……

'Dear Friends of Wutong Lane, if you are sitting on our favourite park bench today...' Mandarin has no separate word for "favourite"—it simply pairs "zui", "most", with "xihuan", "like": "zui xihuan".
那么九号房的绿色百叶窗又向街坊敞开啦！

'Then Room Nine has opened its green shutters to the neighbourhood once more!' "Baiyechuang" literally says "hundred-leaf window" for slatted wooden shutters, paired with "changkai", "flung wide open".
再听下一行：三十个夏天以前，五个朋友定下了一个星期六的约定。

'Listen to the next line: Thirty summers ago, five friends made a Saturday promise.' Summers take the general counter "ge"—"sanshi ge xiatian"—while "ding xia" means settling firmly on a shared promise.
小晴，当年我的教授和小院的朋友们定了什么约定呀？
'What promise did my professor and the courtyard crew make back then, Qing?' Nostalgic "dangnian" means "back in those years", looking fondly across decades to a cherished moment in the past.
在红星阳台挂上灯笼，再一起分享莓果杏仁蛋糕！
'To hang lanterns from the red-star balcony and share berry almond cake again!' "Gua shang" joins "hang" with "up onto", while "fenxiang" pairs "divide" and "enjoy" for sharing cake with friends.
哇，真美好——卡片最底下还有一行备注小字吗？
'Oh, how lovely—and is there a postscript at the bottom of the card?' "Zui dixia" pinpoints "the very bottom", and "beizhu" names an extra note or postscript tucked beneath a message.
快看：这个星期留意前台的信箱，因为我说话算话！
'Look: Watch your front-desk mail this week, because I keep my promises!' "Shuohua suanhua" literally says "spoken words count as words"—a punchy everyday saying for "I keep my promises!".
等等——两个星期前他已经从国外寄来第一张明信片了！
'Wait—he already mailed that first postcard from abroad two weeks ago!' "Mingxinpian" literally means "open-letter slice"—mail sent without an envelope—and "ji lai" adds "sent our way".
会不会我们出门走路的时候，第二封消息已经到小院客栈了？！
'What if a second message arrived at Courtyard Inn while we were out walking?!' Leading with "hui buhui", "might it be that...", voices a sudden hunch, and letters take the counter "feng", "seal".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
小晴，轻轻掀开信封口吧；这个小信封从五月起就耐心等着了。
里面是一张折好的米白卡片，用的还是那种干净利落的制图员墨水！
小晴，请把每个字都大声念给我们听吧。
亲爱的梧桐巷朋友们，如果你们今天坐在我们最喜欢的公园长椅上……
那么九号房的绿色百叶窗又向街坊敞开啦！
再听下一行：三十个夏天以前，五个朋友定下了一个星期六的约定。
小晴，当年我的教授和小院的朋友们定了什么约定呀？
在红星阳台挂上灯笼，再一起分享莓果杏仁蛋糕！
哇，真美好——卡片最底下还有一行备注小字吗？
快看：这个星期留意前台的信箱，因为我说话算话！
等等——两个星期前他已经从国外寄来第一张明信片了！
会不会我们出门走路的时候，第二封消息已经到小院客栈了？！
The thirty-year promise is clear: balcony lanterns, summer berry cake, and a mapmaker who always keeps his word! See you back at the front desk next time.
回头见！
